claims.head: Washington lets teams in close, and Tampa Bay goes there
claims.call: Tampa Bay needs no more than its usual 15.3 unblocked shots per expected goal.
claims.body: Washington has struggled to keep shots to the perimeter (24th of 32), and Tampa Bay makes its shots count: one expected goal for every 15.3 unblocked shots, 7th in the league.

claims.head: Tampa Bay hounds the puck; Washington sits back
claims.body: On forecheck pressure, Tampa Bay sits 9th of 32, at the hounding end of the scale. Washington is 30th, at the passive end.
claims.call: Tampa Bay puts more forecheck pressure on than Washington.

TBL.head: The matchup suits Tampa Bay
TBL.body: Tampa Bay has had more of the chances over recent games, Washington is playing for the second night in a row, and Tampa Bay has home ice. Washington’s way back in is getting to the dangerous areas.

WSH.head: A tough matchup for Washington
WSH.body: Tampa Bay has had more of the chances over recent games, Washington is playing for the second night in a row, and Tampa Bay has home ice. Washington can pull it off if it gets to the dangerous areas.
